brands.evidence: Yes, Monzo is safe. It is a fully licensed and regulated UK bank

client_claims.text: Eligible deposits are automatically protected up to £85,000 per person.
client_claims.note: Fact says FSCS protection is up to £120,000 per person, not £85,000.

client_claims.text: Joint accounts: protection limit doubles to £170,000 (£85,000 each).
client_claims.note: Based on £85,000 per person; the fact gives £120,000 per person.

client_claims.text: Monzo Bank Limited is authorised by the PRA and regulated by both the FCA and the PRA.
Monzo is a fully licensed and regulated UK bank.
The FSCS aims to pay back protected money usually within 7 to 15 working days.
Fixed-term or notice savings pots are provided by partner banks such as OakNorth, Paragon, Charter Savings Bank.
Monzo can instantly freeze and unfreeze the card via the app, with real-time notifications, and biometrics/PIN app access.
Monzo adheres to the Contingent Reimbursement Model rules to refund APP fraud victims.
Monzo Investments funds are managed by BlackRock, and FSCS covers up to £85,000.
client_claims.note: The £85,000 figure conflicts with F5's limit but this concerns investments, which the fact does not cover.
